mechanism_claims.claim_text: LP90 anti-pneumococcal activity is consistent with proteinaceous bacteriocins because activity withstood heat treatment and was sensitive to proteinase K.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: S. infantarius LP90 extracellular antimicrobial compounds/CFS
mechanism_claims.limitations: This supports proteinaceous/bacteriocin nature, not a cellular target mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The anti-pneumococcal activity is attributed at least to a modified 3963 Da InfA1 form, while the predicted/unmodified InfA1 mass does not itself show the same inhibitory activity in the source discussion.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The primary source proposes hypotheses for the modification and possible InfA2 contribution; this is not a resolved molecular mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper maps a multibacteriocinogenic class II gene cluster with GG-leader peptide features, secretion/immunity/regulation genes, and transcription of most structural/immunity genes.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: S. infantarius LP90 bacteriocin gene cluster
mechanism_claims.limitations: Genetic/transcriptional context supports bacteriocin production but does not establish a target-cell mechanism of action.
